data.narrative:
CuspAI is a Series A AI & Software company founded by Max Welling and Chad Edwards that has raised $100M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR), including peers such as Reflection AI, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Applied Intuition at similar or adjacent stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $100M total raised as a base proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying a $200M valuation. Peer-median methodology examines 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B), and Field AI ($2.0B Series B). This peer set yields a median valuation of $4.4B with a range of $2.0B to $25.0B.

The triangulated analysis produces a low estimate of $170M, median of $2.3B, and high of $5.1B. The wide dispersion—particularly the outlier Reflection AI valuation at $25.0B—creates substantial uncertainty around point estimates. Key drivers of valuation within this range include: proof points on revenue and unit economics not captured here, market position within frontier AI relative to the peer set, and the maturity of product-market fit at Series A stage. The gap between stage-progression ($200M) and peer-median ($4.4B) suggests either that CuspAI's early traction lags peer benchmarks or that frontier-AI valuations remain heterogeneous.
